description: Ensign于1946年推出的折叠相机。配备Ensar Anastigmat 105mm or 100mm (uncommon), f4.5。快门速度T, B, 1/150s, 1/100s, 1/50s, 1/25s, 1/10s, 1/5s, 1/2s, 1s。使用120 roll medium format。

specs.取景器: lens-mounted brilliant finder and folding glassless eye finder upon top-plate
specs.尺寸: 6×9cm; 8 exposures per roll, 6×6; 12 exposures per roll
specs.英文简介: The Ensign Selfix 420 is a folding camera sold by Ensign from 1946.
